open_points.subject: 40_flows.md:`flow:start_instance`
open_points.text: “a close that fails is named in a diagnostic of its own” contradicts “one diagnostic naming the first failed item”
open_points.question: When opening the service API listener fails and closing the already-open owner listener also fails, does the stopped start produce both diagnostics or only the first listener-open diagnostic?
options: Produce two diagnostics: the listener-open failure first and a separate listener-close failure diagnostic
Produce only the listener-open diagnostic and suppress the close failure
Produce one combined diagnostic containing both failures
open_points.default_guess: Produce two diagnostics, preserving the listener-open failure as the primary diagnostic and adding the close failure as its own diagnostic.

witness.initial: A non-owner-only start has passed configuration, backup and store checks; the owner-interface listener is open and the service-API listener is not.
events: module:instance_lifecycle tries to open the service-API listener and the operation fails.
module:instance_lifecycle tries to close the owner-interface listener and that close fails.
The process ends and releases the owner-interface listener.
outcomes: The Steps passage produces a diagnostic for the service-API listener-open failure and another diagnostic of its own for the owner-listener close failure.
The Outcomes passage produces one diagnostic naming only the first failed item.
witness.observer: The owner or host administrator reading the start diagnostics
